answer:
I don't know the exact figure, so I can't give you a reliable number. My recollection is that the Windows installer is on the order of a gigabyte or more because it bundles GPU runtime libraries (CUDA and ROCm), and the installed footprint is likely several gigabytes. Treat that as a rough guess, not a measured value.

To get the real number before installing:

- Check the download size on the Ollama download page or the release assets on GitHub.
- After installing, measure the install folder (by default under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Ollama`) in PowerShell with `(Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ollama" -Recurse | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB`.

Models are stored separately, by default under `%USERPROFILE%\.ollama\models`, so they won't count toward the binary's footprint.
